key_insight: KaiNinja extends a native single-object 3D generator to produce part-level assets by replacing the fused O-Voxel representation with a dual-volume form that can represent part interfaces without a separate segmenter.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast, mask-free generation of editable, riggable, and simulation-ready 3D parts while preserving the quality and speed of the underlying TRELLIS.2 backbone.
method: Build on TRELLIS.2's O-Voxel generator with a dual-volume representation to encode touching parts separately.
Train on mixed part-level data, including CAD models and LLM-agent-authored assets.
Generate part-level 3D directly, avoiding post-hoc segmentation or mask prediction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved whole-object fidelity and part accuracy, including 40% lower Chamfer distance and 16% higher strict part F-score versus other part generation pipelines.
watch_item: A dual-volume approach adds representation complexity, so practical performance may depend on robust training data coverage for fine part interfaces and contact regions.
paper_title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
